config.notes: Courses are bound by hand to their own programme page in the current MacEwan calendar (calendar.macewan.ca/programs/degree-programs/<programme>/, 2027-2028 edition); identity is manual. These pages print the credential (page title "<Major> - Bachelor of <X> | MacEwan University Academic Catalog") and the credits for the degree (120 credits / four-year), which the adapter reads as study_level and duration. They do NOT print intake months, IELTS scores, delivery mode or any fee: English points to MacEwan.ca/ELP (attached as english_policy), terms to the Academic Schedule (attached as intake_calendar; current schedule already attached), fees to the calendar fee section (address not found in any stored text). No intakes, english, fee or mode pattern is set, so nothing is admitted from this adapter.
